relation_types.name: related
relation_types.description: General association between concepts that are connected but not specifically categorized

relation_types.name: parent
relation_types.description: Direct hierarchical parent relationship (category tree)

relation_types.name: child
relation_types.description: Direct hierarchical child relationship (category tree)

relation_types.name: synonym
relation_types.description: Terms that have the same or nearly identical meaning

relation_types.name: opposite
relation_types.description: Terms that have contrasting or opposite meanings

relation_types.name: used_with
relation_types.description: Terms that are commonly used together or in combination

relation_types.name: requires
relation_types.description: Term A requires term B to be present or performed

relation_types.name: required_by
relation_types.description: Term B is required by term A

relation_types.name: part_of
relation_types.description: Term A is a component or part of term B

relation_types.name: contains
relation_types.description: Term A contains term B as a component

relation_types.name: see_also
relation_types.description: Cross-reference to related but distinct topics for further reading

relation_types.name: causes
relation_types.description: Term A produces or results in term B

relation_types.name: caused_by
relation_types.description: Term A is produced or results from term B

relation_types.name: results_in
relation_types.description: Term A leads to or results in term B as an effect

relation_types.name: result_of
relation_types.description: Term A is the result or effect of term B

relation_types.name: similar_to
relation_types.description: Terms that are similar in nature or function but not exact synonyms

relation_types.name: differs_from
relation_types.description: Terms that are related but have distinct differences

relation_types.name: contrast_with
relation_types.description: Terms that highlight differences when compared
examples: power break contrasts with controlled break
aggressive play contrasts with safety play

relation_types.name: subtype_of
relation_types.description: Term A is a specific variation of term B

relation_types.name: supertype_of
relation_types.description: Term A is the general category that includes term B

relation_types.name: applied_to
relation_types.description: Term A is applied to or used with term B

relation_types.name: applied_by
relation_types.description: Term A is applied using term B

relation_types.name: influences
relation_types.description: Term A has an effect or influence on term B

relation_types.name: influenced_by
relation_types.description: Term A is affected or determined by term B

relation_types.name: enables
relation_types.description: Term A makes term B possible or feasible

relation_types.name: enabled_by
relation_types.description: Term A is made possible by term B

relation_types.name: prerequisite_for
relation_types.description: Term A must be learned or mastered before term B

relation_types.name: builds_on
relation_types.description: Term A builds upon or requires prior knowledge of term B

relation_types.name: leads_to
relation_types.description: Term A naturally progresses to term B

relation_types.name: developed_from
relation_types.description: Term A has evolved or been derived from term B

relation_types.name: commonly_with
relation_types.description: Term A frequently occurs together with term B

relation_types.name: alternative_for
relation_types.description: Term A can be used as an alternative to term B

relation_types.name: confused_with
relation_types.description: Terms that are frequently confused with each other

relation_types.name: opposed_to
relation_types.description: Term A is in opposition to term B

relation_types.name: depends_on
relation_types.description: Term A is dependent on term B for its effectiveness

relation_types.name: required_for
relation_types.description: Term A is necessary for term B to be effective

relation_types.name: replaces
relation_types.description: Term A is a newer or improved version replacing term B

relation_types.name: replaced_by
relation_types.description: Term A has been superseded by term B

relation_types.name: category_of
relation_types.description: Term A belongs to the category of term B

relation_types.name: has_category
relation_types.description: Term A includes or has the category term B

relation_types.name: instance_of
relation_types.description: Term A is a specific instance or example of term B

relation_types.name: has_instance
relation_types.description: Term A has specific instances or examples like term B

relation_types.name: precedes
relation_types.description: Term A comes before term B in sequence or importance

relation_types.name: follows
relation_types.description: Term A comes after term B in sequence or importance

relation_types.name: associated_with
relation_types.description: Term A has a general association with term B

relation_types.name: measure_of
relation_types.description: Term A is a measurement or metric for term B

relation_types.name: measured_by
relation_types.description: Term A is measured using term B

relation_types.name: comprises
relation_types.description: Term A is made up of term B and others

relation_types.name: opponent_action
relation_types.description: Term A is an action taken in response to term B by opponent

relation_types.name: response_to
relation_types.description: Term A is a response to term B by opponent
